title: obex: Use unique IDs for packet reassembly
description:
The OBEX dissector currently uses the packet direction as an ID for reassembling
fragmented packets. This data is not unique for grouping fragmented packets
together. Instead, use the frame number of the first fragment in a sequence as
the reassembly ID.

obex: Use unique IDs for packet reassembly

The OBEX dissector currently uses the packet direction as an ID for reassembling
fragmented packets. This data is not unique for grouping fragmented packets
together. Instead, use the frame number of the first fragment in a sequence as
the reassembly ID.
